We already know that 1 day = 24 hours, then 48 days = 48 × 24 = 1152 hours. Also, 1 hour = 60 minutes, then 1152 hours = 1152 × 60 = 69120 minutes. Now, 1 minute = 60 seconds, then 69120 minutes = 69120 × 60 = 4147200 seconds. So Sadika stayed in her village home for a total of 4147200 seconds. 134
